pairs = {'(': ')', '{': '}', '<': '>', '[': ']'}
closers = set(pairs.values())

inp = "( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ]".split()
sub = "( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ] ) ] ) ]".split()

def process(tokens):
    stack = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t in pairs:
            stack.append(t)
        elif t in closers:
            if not stack or pairs[stack[-1]] != t:
                return stack, False
            stack.pop()
        else:
            return stack, False
    return stack, True

stack, ok = process(inp)

expected_completion = [pairs[c] for c in reversed(stack)]
expected_full = inp + expected_completion
